measurementProtocol.controls: For each fault mode execute one matched healthy/no-fault control and one injected-fault arm using identical sealed config. Retained equivalent controls may be reused only with exact coverage attribution. Do not run unsafe/blocked arms.
measurementProtocol.denominators: False-negative numerator=eligible injected faults not detected within deadline; denominator=executed eligible injections. False-positive numerator=healthy controls wrongly classified as fault; denominator=executed eligible healthy controls. Report counts and denominators; blocked/unexecuted arms excluded and listed separately. Target0/each executed denominator. No inferred population reliability from small samples.
measurementProtocol.latency: Use external monotonic clock. t0 is confirmed injection activation; tDetect is first durable matching detector event; tVerify is independent fresh oracle confirmation. Report raw per-arm durations, min/max and nearest-rank p50/p95 with sample count. No execution result inferred from a design threshold.
measurementProtocol.recovery: Recovery time=tVerify-t0 only for safely repairable cases; containment/escalation cases report escalation latency and keep recovery=N/A. Fresh observedAt is separately checked against wall-clock fault and verifier start, not a substitute for monotonic timing.
measurementProtocol.resources: Sample process-tree RSS and cumulative CPU every5seconds using external observer; record all gaps. Endurance compares first/last complete5minute median RSS. Record row/job throughput per interval, backlog, actual retry/execute entries, source stale age and local/hosted cost receipts; unknown charge remains unknown.
measurementProtocol.F29: t0 is confirmed process stop/kill. Production worker no-progress600s remains; detector deadline660s includes60s observation margin. Immediate death modes additionally record actual faster latency; never claim600s stall proof from accelerated tests.
measurementProtocol.failedRun: Any unsafe effect, lost history, financial invariant breach or authority bypass is criticalFAIL/NO_GO. Preserve failed trace and exact repair/retest link; stop affected arm safely.
